question: Can EvidPort unify its package/CLI naming on `evidport` with 100% `evidence_database` shim identity, shared v1 golden contract vectors, and quantified OCR-hazard holdback reduction?
summary: Fast-forward merged `feat/evidport-unified-naming` (`eaa50a9`) onto local `main` (533/533 pytest, Ruff, and public-tree check passed; Stage-5 3-vendor gate `accepted_with_dissent` 2/3) and linked Track-A real-PDF OCR hazard evaluation (`4,549` sentences across 11 biomedical PDFs) and P3 (`N=48`) Stage-4 benchmark receipts. Remote push deferred pending user confirmation.

decisions.title: Unify canonical distribution on `evidport` with `_EvidPortCompatFinder` / `_DualNameLoader` shims
decisions.summary: Expose `evidport` and `evidport-mcp` as canonical entry points while preserving `sys.modules['evidence_database'] is evidport` across submodule imports, explicit `__init__` imports, and `runpy.run_module(..., alter_sys=True)`.

evidence.locator: Unified EvidPort naming and shared contract vectors

decisions.title: Adopt hybrid position-quoted hazard gating guidance from Track-A 11-PDF evaluation
decisions.summary: `compute_quote_hazards` + position quoting reduces clean-PDF human holdback from 27.72% (blanket dual-track OCR) to 11.91% (-57.02% relative; 13.81% / -50.20% in hybrid mode) while catching 48/48 (100%) transcription/hyphenation defects.
